## MORE THAN 20,000 ARTICLES.

**+** LASER COMPONENTS is your partner for detectors, emitters, fiber optics, and optics. The
applications for laser optics and optoelectronics are as diverse as the technologies themselves:
Sensor technology, range finding, biotechnology with environmental and life science, aerospace &
defense, science and research or medical technology are just a few examples. Our product engineers
keep track of everything in this complex world. They work with you to find the best technologies and
products to match your application. Many components in our portfolio are made at our own production
sites. Most of them are the result of customer-cooperation, because at LASER COMPONENTS, we go
“beyond borders” to ensure your success.

**Exceptionally Low-Loss Electro-Optic Modulators, Switches, and Custom Integrated Optical
Circuits**

[Product Brochure][56]

EOSPACE, Inc specializes in manufacturing the highest performance electro-optic (EO) integrated
circuits and components for the designers and builders of next-generation optical telecommunication
and photonic systems. Our name represents our commitment to designing great products to research and
explore electro-optics.

EOSPACE products utilize proprietary lithium niobate (LiNbO3) integrated optics devices to produce
exceptionally low insertion loss and broad bandwidth devices.

Our state-of-the-art optical integrated circuit technology is developed under ongoing research,
driven by very demanding aerospace applications requiring high-frequency microwave and low loss
photonic fiber-optic transmission. High-performance wideband commercial telecommunications,
research, and aerospace applications also use EOSPACE optical IC technology.

## FOR THE **PHOTONICS INDUSTRY**

You have an idea for a new and unprecedented application, but you cannot find the right components
anywhere? Welcome to LASER COMPONENTS. We are your sparring partner for optics, optoelectronics, and
all light-related technologies. Together with you, we go beyond borders and realize your visions.

keep track of everything in this complex world. They work with you to find the best technologies and
products to match your application. Many components in our portfolio are made at our own production

“beyond borders” to ensure your success.

    * * * #### SuperK series
          
          The SuperK series is an industry-leading range of turn-key supercontinuum white light
          lasers used by the most innovative companies within bio-imaging, semicon, device
          characterization, and scientific instrumentation.
    * * * #### Most popular
    * * * #### SuperK FIANIUM
          
          High-end white light lasers
      * * #### SuperK EVO
          
          Industrial lasers for OEM integration
      * * #### SuperK CHROMATUNE
          
          The world’s broadest tunable laser
    * * * [See all SuperK series][8]
  * [Single-frequency fiber lasers][9]
    * * * #### Koheras series
          
          Koheras single-frequency lasers offer narrow linewidth and extremely low phase- and
          intensity noise levels. Available in the Erbium or Ytterbium wavelength ranges and with
          frequency conversion to many other bands. The all-fiber DFB design ensures robust and
          reliable operation for thousands of hours.
    * * * #### Most popular
    * * * #### Koheras MIKRO
          
          Robust and compact OEM laser modules
      * * #### Koheras ACOUSTIK
          
          Modular line card laser and amplifier system
      * * #### Koheras HARMONIK
          
          High power UV & VIS fiber lasers
    * * * [See all Koheras lasers][10]
  * [Ultrafast lasers][11]
    * * * #### Ultrafast Lasers
          
          Our robust ultrafast lasers are available both as fiber lasers and solid state lasers.
          Whether you need picosecond or femtosecond lasers this is for you.
    * * * #### Most popular
    * * * #### aeroPULSE FS10
          
          Flexible femtosecond laser
      * * #### aeroPULSE FS50
          
          High power femtosecond fiber laser
      * * #### ORIGAMI XPS
          
          High energy femtosecond lasers
    * * * [See all ultrafast lasers][12]
  * [Optical fibers and modules][13]
    * * * #### Photonic crystal fibers and gain modules
          
          Optical fibers are at the heart of everything we do. From nonlinear fibers for
          octave-spanning supercontinuum generation, over the World’s largest single-mode ytterbium
          gain fibers for high power lasers and amplifiers, to advanced hollow-core fibers guiding
          the light in air.
    * * * #### Most popular
    * * * #### aeroGAIN-BASE
          
          High power ytterbium fiber gain modules
      * * #### aeroGUIDE fibers
          
          Broadband single-mode fiber delivery
      * * #### Gain fibers
          
          Ytterbium large mode area double clad fibers
    * * * [See all fibers & modules][14]

## [Tuning Light with AI: A Universal Calibration Framework][30]

13.07.2026 by [avetissian][31]

essential for advanced computing and signal processing, but achieving optimal performance
necessitates sophisticated calibration methods; tandem neural networks address inherent ambiguities
in these systems by first learning hardware imperfections and then predicting precise control
currents needed to realize desired optical responses - effectively resolving the many-to-one problem
common in photonic mesh designs.]

*Researchers have developed an artificial intelligence-powered system that dramatically improves the
precision and adaptability of programmable photonic processors.*

self-assembled nanosphere structures used in photonics, sensing, coatings, drug delivery, and
nanosphere lithography. It concludes that multimodal imaging, standardized datasets, and
data-efficient machine learning could improve quantitative inspection and feedback-guided assembly.

CCRAFT is a Swiss-based photonic chip foundry committed to advancing high-performance thin-film
lithium niobate (TFLN) technology for scalable, high-volume manufacturing. Built on over six years
of pioneering R&D at CSEM (the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology), we deliver

### Telecom & Datacom

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

TFLN EO modulators transform high-speed optical communication with data rates exceeding 400 Gbit/s,
positioning them as essential for next-generation telecom and datacom systems. Their
multi-wavelength and low-power operation across O-band, C-band, L-band, and S-band enhance DWDM
system efficiency, supporting both short-distance intra-datacenter links and long-haul
communication. CMOS integration enables compact, energy-efficient transceiver designs, ideal for
high-port interconnects and rack-to-rack connectivity. Integrated EO polarization controllers and
tunable filters further boost bandwidth and spectral efficiency, addressing the needs of modern
high-performance networks.

### High-Performance Computing & AI

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

AI and HPC systems require unprecedented data transmission speeds, but current interconnect
technologies have reached their fundamental limits. TFLN EO modulators address this challenge with
ultrafast, low-power optical modulation and simplified electronics, enabling seamless GPU-to-GPU and
node-to-node communication. Designed for next-generation AI and HPC architectures, TFLN integrates
effortlessly with advanced packaging technologies such as co-packaged optics and 3D chip stacking.
These innovations enable scalable, low-latency solutions that are critical for accelerating AI
training, inference, and high-performance computing workloads.

quantum control; Quantum communication: entangled photon pair generation, polarization control, and

sources.

  ### [Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells][94]
  
  We are experts in the field of Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells. BBO-based Pockels Cell are used
  to change the polarization state of light passing through it when an voltage is applied to the
  electrodes of BBO Electro-optic Components. Typical applications include Q-switching of the laser
  cavity, laser cavity dumping and coupling light into and from regenerative amplifiers. Low
  piezoelectric ringing makes BBO Pockels Cells attractive for the control of high-power and high
  repetition rate lasers. Fast switching electronic drivers properly matched to the cell are
  available for Q-switches , cavity dumping and other applications.

**Exceptionally Low-Loss Electro-Optic Modulators, Switches, and Custom Integrated Optical
Circuits**

[Product Brochure][56]

EOSPACE, Inc specializes in manufacturing the highest performance electro-optic (EO) integrated
circuits and components for the designers and builders of next-generation optical telecommunication
and photonic systems. Our name represents our commitment to designing great products to research and
explore electro-optics.

EOSPACE products utilize proprietary lithium niobate (LiNbO3) integrated optics devices to produce
exceptionally low insertion loss and broad bandwidth devices.

Our state-of-the-art optical integrated circuit technology is developed under ongoing research,
driven by very demanding aerospace applications requiring high-frequency microwave and low loss
photonic fiber-optic transmission. High-performance wideband commercial telecommunications,
research, and aerospace applications also use EOSPACE optical IC technology.

G&H delivers advanced photonics engineering and manufacturing solutions for industrial, telecoms,
aerospace, defense, space, quantum, and life sciences applications.

customers with the solutions they need. Whatever the application or environment, we can work with
you to enable greater system efficiency and effectiveness.

Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

# Room-Temperature Wafer Bonding for Next-Generation Photonics

Partow Technologies enables next-generation heterogeneous integration through advanced
room-temperature Surface Activated Bonding (SAB) and thin-film transfer technologies. Our platform
supports the integration of lithium niobate, GaN, SiC, diamond, and other advanced materials for
high-performance photonic, RF, quantum, and semiconductor applications.

By eliminating the need for high-temperature bonding, Partow’s SAB technology reduces thermal
stress, preserves material integrity, and enables scalable integration of dissimilar materials that
are difficult or impossible to combine using conventional processes.

Our technologies support a broad range of emerging applications, including AI datacenter photonics,
optical interconnects, electro-optic sensing, microwave photonics, THz systems, quantum photonics,
and advanced power electronics.

## Our Leadership

##  

## Payam Rabie, Ph.D.

## Founder & CEO

## Dr. Payam Rabie founded Partow Technologies to advance next-generation semiconductor and photonic
## manufacturing. He leads the company's strategy, product development, and commercialization, with
## a focus on innovative room-temperature wafer bonding technologies and thin-film lithium niobate
## (TFLN) photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platforms.

## About Us

## Our Capabilities

Partow provides expertise across the full integration stack, including:
* Surface Activated Wafer Bonding
* Ion-Sliced Thin-Film Transfer
* Thin-Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN)
* Heterogeneous Photonic Integration
* Advanced Wafer Engineering
* Electro-Optic Devices and Sensors

Our capabilities include wafer-scale bonding, photonic device fabrication, process development, and
custom substrate engineering for research, defense, and commercial markets.

Partow Technologies is advancing the future of photonic and semiconductor integration through
scalable, low-temperature manufacturing solutions for next-generation systems.

ProChem’s mission is to synthesize high purity inorganic compounds and custom precursors for
advanced materials applications. We pride ourselves on our customer’s satisfaction as we provide
innovative solutions to their unique needs.

ProChem’s team focuses on personal and quick responses to orders and quotation requests to ensure
the customer is getting exactly what they need for their processes. As a versatile manufacturing
company, we are always expanding our products to meet our customer's exact requirements. Our
in-house analytical capabilities allow for quick and reliable in-process testing to guarantee the

#### Press Release

### **Quantum Computing Inc. Appoints Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer and Creates Chief Product
### Officer Role to Accelerate Commercial Growth**

[Read the press release][11]

### Welcoming a new team

QCi is proud to welcome NHanced, NuCrypt, Freedom Photonics, EM4, and Optogration to the QCi family
to accelerate our transition from technology innovation to scalable manufacturing, reinforcing our
mission to put quantum-enabled solutions into the hands of people.

### NHanced

At NHanced Semiconductors we transform bleeding-edge designs into state-of-the-art 3DICs and 2.5D
assemblies.

[Visit their site][12]

### NuCrypt

NuCrypt develops inter-disciplinary technologies for emerging applications in communications and
metrology.

[Visit their site][13]

### Freedom Photonics

Freedom Photonics is a leader in design, development and manufacturing of unique and innovative
photonics components, modules and subsystems.

[Visit their site][14]

### EM4

EM4 is a leader in high-performance photonics components, modules and subassemblies with a long
heritage as a preferred supplier for leading aerospace and defense contractors around the globe.

[Visit their site][15]

### Optogration

Optogration is a leader in advanced photodetectors and detector-based components with extremely high
sensitivity and wide dynamic range for mission-critical applications.

[Visit their site][16]

## Who we are

At QCi, we build practical, scalable, room-temperature quantum photonics products that harness the
quantum nature of light to capture data, compute complex information, and securely communicate
across networks.

Our integrated quantum photonic solutions are engineered to solve real-world challenges by saving
time, reducing costs, and simplifying critical decisions.

We transform advanced quantum science into powerful tools that help people and businesses focus on
what matters most.

[vision]

## Whom we work with

We are proud to have partnered and collaborated with various industry partners, big and small.

## About QCi

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that
provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to
operate room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core
technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing,
artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

### Publications

QCi has technical talent with a range of expertise that have been publishing papers, patents, and
other scientific material. The publications fall within the categories of quantum computing,
reservoir computing, cybersecrity, biomedical imaging, remote sensing, and quantum communication.

[See publications][17]

### Join our team

We are always looking to hire world-class talent who are passionate about developing disruptive
technology that will have a positive impact on the world. Does that sound like you? Join us.

Self-Forcing Braided Sleeve Gripper: A Soft Robotics Approach to Offshore Conductor Removal

][9]
Master thesis (2026) - [C. Dielas][10], [J. Jovanova][11], J. Breukels, [V.G. Kortman][12], [H.L.
McQuillan][13], [Jieun Yang][14]

Offshore decommissioning is accelerating asageing oil and gas infrastructure reaches the end of its
service life. In theNorth Sea alone, over 2,650 wells are scheduled between 2025 and 2034, and
wellplug and abandonment accounted for 49% of decommissioning expenditure on the UKContinental Shelf
in 2024. Within this scope, conductor removal, the extractionof large-diameter vertical steel pipes
connecting subsea wells to surfacefacilities, remains a persistent operational bottleneck. Current
practice relieson the cut-and-pull method, in which the entire lifting load is transferredthrough a
single conductor cross-section. Its applicability is thereforegoverned by the structural condition
of that cross-section, as corroded casingsand degraded connections may not sustain the concentrated
load.

This thesis proposes a compliant grippingmechanism that distributes the lifting load over the outer
conductor surface,and examines whether it scales to the multi-tonne loads of conductor removal,
aregime far beyond the small-scale applications to which soft robotic grippershave been confined.
Following a literature study into soft gripping methods anda conceptual design process, four
concepts were evaluated, from which a braidedconstriction sleeve gripper was selected. Its defining
property is aself-forcing mechanism, in which the weight of the conductor tightens the braidaround
its surface, so that a heavier load produces a stronger grip.

An analytical model relates the braidgeometry to the holding capacity, which grows exponentially
with adimensionless self-forcing coefficient. This coefficient is the product of thefriction
coefficient and a geometric coefficient scaling with the conductorradius and the square of the
number of braid turns, and inversely with thegripping length. The capacity is supplied passively by
the weight of a bottomring, requiring no continuous actuation. A parametric campaign across
twelveconfigurations, each tested five times, supported the model within the rangeexamined. The
measured capacity scaled linearly with the ring weight at fixedgeometry, rose far more steeply with
the geometric coefficient than preloadfriction alone permits, following the exponential form
characteristic ofself-forcing, and followed the predicted direction for each geometric
parametervaried in isolation. A single friction coefficient of approximately 0.135reproduced the
measured capacity across differing geometries, supporting thecontact assumptions. The most tightly
braided configuration sustained more than75 kg without slipping, giving a payload-to-self-weight
ratio of at least 337:1against 16:1 at the baseline.Applied to the NorthCormorant platform, the
model yields an early-phase full-scale design employinga steel wire rope braid of seven turns over a
gripping length of 14 metres,preloaded by a 10 tonne bottom ring. Under a conservative design
frictioncoefficient of 0.10, the holding capacity reaches approximately 18,800 kNagainst a design
lifting weight of 634 kN per conductor section. Slip istherefore not the governing constraint, which
is set instead by the ropestrength at the top ring connection and by the deployment of the braid. To
theauthor's knowledge, this constitutes the first compliant gripping conceptmodelled, experimentally
supported, and dimensioned for offshore removals atthe multi-tonne scale. ... Read more

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

### [ Automotive ][57]

With automotive manufacturing operations found in every corner of the world, first, second and third
tier automotive suppliers, EMSs (Electronic Manufacturing Services), and contract manufacturers
often have needs for components in shortage or only available with long lead times. VRG Components
fills their supply gaps quickly & efficiently.

[ [Hand touching a medical electronics touch screen with a yellow filter] ][59]

### [ Medical Electronics ][60]

Medical device manufacturers use an extensive variety of electronic parts. When a crucial component
is unavailable from their primary suppliers, they turn to us. Our focus on delivering first quality
components backed by our AS9120 certified processes provide the peace of mind these manufacturers
demand.

[Go to industry][61]
[ [Automotive highway at night with blurred lights from cars and a gold filter] ][62]

### [ Transportation ][63]

Mass media communications systems in modern public transportation (rail cars, buses, terminals,
highways) utilize a vast number of electronic components. Several suppliers manufacturing these
systems exclusively turn to VRG when they need hard-to-find components.

as processes evolve - especially as we embrace IoT (internet Of Things). Maintaining tried and true

## About Us

### VRG Components… Not your Typical Supplier.

VRG Components® is an industry-leading, AS9120 certified, independent worldwide distributor of
electronic components, semiconductors, and network components from hundreds of product
manufacturers. We specialize in global sourcing services for new, allocated, end-of-life, last-time
buy (LTB), and long lead time electronic components from a wide range of leading brands.

VRG Components is unlike other independent distributors you might know. Where other companies may
lack quality standards, we are committed to quality and maintain AS9120 certifications.

Our sales team speaks your language, from German to Spanish, and we work hard to build meaningful
and long-term relationships with our customers and vendors located in every corner of the world. Our
customers love doing business with VRG, and we value being there for you when you need us.

### Make finding crucial components our challenge, not yours – it’s what we do.

Allow us to be your choice partner in sourcing shortage and difficult-to-find parts today.

Where competitors are slow to deliver or don’t at all, we go above and beyond for you, our customer.
And we’re different in that we specialize in finding parts no one else can. We’re not like other
distributors and are proud of it.

Now, we know that component sourcing can be challenging. VRG Components, with over 50 years of
industry expertise, a multi-lingual sourcing team, and unmatched access to exclusive global
inventory, is uniquely positioned to serve your needs.

[**Learn more about how we do it in this video.**][70]

### Did you know we’re committed to turning around quick quotes?

VRG Components is committed to fast, accurate quotes and top-tier service. Reach out to your sales
executive for a quick quote on a part you need, within 30 minutes or less. Just have your
manufacturer name and part number ready.

## Search in WebThesis

[Advanced search][14]

Webthesis portal gives access to the electronic archive of Politecnico's Master's degree theses and
meritorious theses in Architecture.

You can find in full text format:
* Master's degree theses of the courses in Cinema and Media Engineering, Electrical Engineering,
  Territorial, Urban, Environmental and Landscape Planning discussed in July 2017 (Academic Year
  2016/17);
* Most of the Master's degree theses discussed in the graduation session of October and December
  2017 (AY 2017/18);
* Master's theses of Politecnico discussed from 2018 on (AY 2017/2018).

Webthesis includes also records with abstracts for:
* The meritorious theses in Architecture discussed since 1996;
* All the Master's theses in Architecture discussed since 2010 with bibliography, index of chapters
  and tables.

Bibliographic data of the theses delivered to the Registrar's Office in electronic format and not
authorized to public consultation are also included (full-text not available).

Refer to the [contact][15] page to request changes to the accessibility of the theses.

# [Yue YU][1]

[View My GitHub Profile][2]

[NICE Hiking experience!]

## Hallo! This is Yue YU（俞越）!

I am currently a postdoc at [University of California, Berkeley][3] and supervised by Prof. Mengjie
Yu. Before that, I spent six years at [CUHK][4] as a postgraduate student. Pls kindly check my
latest [CV][5].

During my postgraduate studies, I focus on design, fabrication, and characterization of
high-performance micro/nanodevices on various integrated photonic platforms including lithium
niobate on insulator, silicon on insulator, silica, etc. My works can be divided into following two
parts:

### (Ⅰ) Ultralow-loss integrated photonics on lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) platform
1. By applying the principle of “bound states in the continuum (BICs)”, high-performance integrated
   photonic devices were developed on a new hybrid photonic architecture at near-visible
   wavelengths, which allows confining and guiding photons using low-refractive-index waveguides
   without etching of the single-crystal substrate. Based on this strategy, a series of fundamental
   components, including waveguides, microcavities, power splitter, Mach-Zehnder interferometers,
   multimode directional couplers, were demonstrated on this platform. This work has been published
   in [[Adv. Opt. Mater. 9, 2100060 (2021)][6]].
2. On-chip arrayed waveguide gratings (AWGs) with the best reported performance yet was achieved on
   lithium niobate integrated photonic platforms. The demonstrated AWGs will enable new applications
   in high-capacity telecommunication, high-resolution imaging, and high-speed sensing. This work
   has been published in [[ACS Photonics 9, 3253–3259 (2022)][7]].
3. Acousto-optic modulation was explored on this platform to leverage the strong piezoelectric
   effect on LiNbO3. This research results have been published in [[Nanophotonics 10, 4323
   (2021)][8]]. This efficient acousto-optic modulation was further utilized to build a on-chip
   multiple passband microwave photonic (MWP) filter. Compared with former MWP filters, ours feature
   a high resolution, compact device footprint, and low energy consumption, which can be applied to
   television, mobile, satellite communications, or radar applications, where the center frequency
   is usually fixed and a narrow bandwidth is desired. This work has been published in [[Laser &
   Photon. Rev. 18, 2300385 (2024)][9]].
4. Second-harmonic-generation was also explored on this platform considering the strong optical
   nonlinearity of LiNbO3. . Due to the opposite thermo-optic coefficients of the polymer and
   lithium niobate, this our structure shows a large thermal stability with a wavelength shift of
   only 1.7 nm from 25°C to 100°C. This work has been published in [[Laser & Photon. Rev. 16,
   2100429 (2022)][10]].
5. Due to the generic mechanism of BIC, this architecture can be extended directly to other
   functional materials and easily integrated with 2D materials for different applications in
   optical communications, nonlinear optics at the single-photon level, and scalable photonic
   quantum information processors. Photon emission by sandwiching a monolayer WS2 between a
   BIC-based photonic waveguide and lithium niobate substrate was demonstrated, which holds great
   promise for building on-chip quantum light sources without fabrication challenges. This work havs
   been published in [[Nano Lett. 23, 3209-3216 (2023)][11]].
6. For those who interested on BIC-based etchless PICs, a detailed tutorial including theoretical
   analysis, numerical simulation, and fabrication processes of low-refractive-index PICs was
   published in [[J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 40, 2801-2808 (2023)][12]].

### (Ⅱ) Mechanical bound states in the continuum

To minimize the mechanical dissipation in micro/nanomechanical resonators, the concept of BIC was
applied in the design of optomechanical resonators and, for the first time, the mechanical BICs in
optomechanical resonators were experimentally realized and observed. Compared with conventional
designs, the demonstrated high-quality optomechanical resonators are robust against structural
variations, which substantially reduces the device fabrication difficulties and allows for their
operation in versatile environments. This work has been publised in [[Light Sci. Appl. 11, 328
(2022)][13]].

   wavelengths, which allows confining and guiding photons using low-refractive-index waveguides
   without etching of the single-crystal substrate. Based on this strategy, a series of fundamental
   components, including waveguides, microcavities, power splitter, Mach-Zehnder interferometers,
   multimode directional couplers, were demonstrated on this platform. This work has been published
   in [[Adv. Opt. Mater. 9, 2100060 (2021)][6]].
2. On-chip arrayed waveguide gratings (AWGs) with the best reported performance yet was achieved on
   lithium niobate integrated photonic platforms. The demonstrated AWGs will enable new applications
   in high-capacity telecommunication, high-resolution imaging, and high-speed sensing. This work
   has been published in [[ACS Photonics 9, 3253–3259 (2022)][7]].
3. Acousto-optic modulation was explored on this platform to leverage the strong piezoelectric
   effect on LiNbO3. This research results have been published in [[Nanophotonics 10, 4323
   (2021)][8]]. This efficient acousto-optic modulation was further utilized to build a on-chip
   multiple passband microwave photonic (MWP) filter. Compared with former MWP filters, ours feature
   a high resolution, compact device footprint, and low energy consumption, which can be applied to
   television, mobile, satellite communications, or radar applications, where the center frequency
   is usually fixed and a narrow bandwidth is desired. This work has been published in [[Laser &
   Photon. Rev. 18, 2300385 (2024)][9]].
4. Second-harmonic-generation was also explored on this platform considering the strong optical
   nonlinearity of LiNbO3. . Due to the opposite thermo-optic coefficients of the polymer and
   lithium niobate, this our structure shows a large thermal stability with a wavelength shift of
   only 1.7 nm from 25°C to 100°C. This work has been published in [[Laser & Photon. Rev. 16,
   2100429 (2022)][10]].
5. Due to the generic mechanism of BIC, this architecture can be extended directly to other
   functional materials and easily integrated with 2D materials for different applications in
   optical communications, nonlinear optics at the single-photon level, and scalable photonic
   quantum information processors. Photon emission by sandwiching a monolayer WS2 between a
   BIC-based photonic waveguide and lithium niobate substrate was demonstrated, which holds great
   promise for building on-chip quantum light sources without fabrication challenges. This work havs
   been published in [[Nano Lett. 23, 3209-3216 (2023)][11]].
6. For those who interested on BIC-based etchless PICs, a detailed tutorial including theoretical
   analysis, numerical simulation, and fabrication processes of low-refractive-index PICs was
   published in [[J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 40, 2801-2808 (2023)][12]].

### (Ⅱ) Mechanical bound states in the continuum

To minimize the mechanical dissipation in micro/nanomechanical resonators, the concept of BIC was
applied in the design of optomechanical resonators and, for the first time, the mechanical BICs in
optomechanical resonators were experimentally realized and observed. Compared with conventional
designs, the demonstrated high-quality optomechanical resonators are robust against structural
variations, which substantially reduces the device fabrication difficulties and allows for their
operation in versatile environments. This work has been publised in [[Light Sci. Appl. 11, 328
(2022)][13]].

necessitates sophisticated calibration methods; tandem neural networks address inherent ambiguities
in these systems by first learning hardware imperfections and then predicting precise control
currents needed to realize desired optical responses - effectively resolving the many-to-one problem
common in photonic mesh designs.]

# Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic Chip Foundry

## Your Partner for Scalable TFLN Photonic Chips

CCRAFT is a Swiss-based photonic chip foundry committed to advancing high-performance thin-film
lithium niobate (TFLN) technology for scalable, high-volume manufacturing. Built on over six years
of pioneering R&D at CSEM (the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology), we deliver
rigorously tested and proven integrated photonic solutions from our in-house facility.

### Telecom & Datacom

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

TFLN EO modulators transform high-speed optical communication with data rates exceeding 400 Gbit/s,
positioning them as essential for next-generation telecom and datacom systems. Their
multi-wavelength and low-power operation across O-band, C-band, L-band, and S-band enhance DWDM
system efficiency, supporting both short-distance intra-datacenter links and long-haul
communication. CMOS integration enables compact, energy-efficient transceiver designs, ideal for
high-port interconnects and rack-to-rack connectivity. Integrated EO polarization controllers and
tunable filters further boost bandwidth and spectral efficiency, addressing the needs of modern
high-performance networks.

### High-Performance Computing & AI

[Data center, AI, Quantum Technologies, Space, Sensing, Optical Computing, Microwave Phoonics, 5G, 6
G, IOT]

AI and HPC systems require unprecedented data transmission speeds, but current interconnect
technologies have reached their fundamental limits. TFLN EO modulators address this challenge with
ultrafast, low-power optical modulation and simplified electronics, enabling seamless GPU-to-GPU and
node-to-node communication. Designed for next-generation AI and HPC architectures, TFLN integrates
effortlessly with advanced packaging technologies such as co-packaged optics and 3D chip stacking.
These innovations enable scalable, low-latency solutions that are critical for accelerating AI
training, inference, and high-performance computing workloads.

G, IOT]

wavelengths; Ultra-fast pulse generation, pure phase modulation, and low-loss performance for
quantum control; Quantum communication: entangled photon pair generation, polarization control, and
EO gating; Photonic quantum computing: programmable MZI meshes, cluster states, and squeezed light
sources.

CMOS-compatible integration for compact, deployable systems; Dielectric resilience to high

  repetition rate lasers. Fast switching electronic drivers properly matched to the cell are

## Featured Products

* [Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells]
  
  ### [Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells][94]
  
  We are experts in the field of Double BBO Crystal Pockels Cells. BBO-based Pockels Cell are used
  to change the polarization state of light passing through it when an voltage is applied to the
  electrodes of BBO Electro-optic Components. Typical applications include Q-switching of the laser
  cavity, laser cavity dumping and coupling light into and from regenerative amplifiers. Low
  piezoelectric ringing makes BBO Pockels Cells attractive for the control of high-power and high
  repetition rate lasers. Fast switching electronic drivers properly matched to the cell are
  available for Q-switches , cavity dumping and other applications.
* [Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell]
  
  ### [Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell][95]
  
  Our Double DKDP (KD*P) Crystal Electro-Optical Cell products have been recognized by our customers
  with advanced production technology and good quality.
* [Potassium Titanyl Phosphate KTP EO Q-Switch]
  
  ### [Potassium Titanyl Phosphate KTP EO Q-Switch][96]
  
  We are experts in the field of Potassium Titanyl Phosphate KTP EO Q-Switch. We are experts in the
  field of Potassium Titanyl Phosphate KTP EO Q-Switch. Potassium TitanyI Phosphahe KTP Pockels Cell
  , which consists of 2 pcs of H-KTP crystal, has very low quarter wave voltage. Coupletech use
  hydrothermal-grown KTP crystal, which overcome the common electrochromicm damage of the flux-grown
  KTP Crystals, KTP Pockels Cells have high resistivity and high damage threshold. H-KTP is suitable
  for making electro-optic devices with excellent properties. Typical application is Q-switching,
  Pulse picking, E-O Modulator, etc.
* [MgO doped Lithium Niobate Electro-Optical Q-switch]
  
  ### [MgO doped Lithium Niobate Electro-Optical Q-switch][97]
  
  Our MgO doped Lithium Niobate Electro-Optical Q-switch is well received in the market. MgO doped
  Lithium Niobate Electro-Optical Q-switch is an excellent EO Q Switch and Pockels Cell. LiNbO3
  crystal and MgO:LiNbO3 crystal are a low cost photoelectric material with good mechanical and
  physical properties as well as good E-O properties. It has been widely used as frequency double,
  optical parametric oscillators, quasi-phase-matched ( QPM ) devices and waveguide substrates as
  well as the most common material for Q-switches ( Pockels cell ) and phase modulators, LiNbO3
  pockels cells are very suitable for applications in Er:YAG, Ho:YAG, Tm:YAG pulsed Solid State
  Laser system.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,

國立陽明交通大學半導體工程學系與之光半導體（Latitude Design Systems, LDS）今日展開學術合作，捐贈 50

Studio予國立陽明交通大學半導體工程學系，導入半導體工程學系之教學與學術研究。PIC Studio
強調系統級設計，能支援異質整合架構下光晶片與電晶片的交互整合，並可一併考量先進封裝寄生效應、均衡演算
法與光纖模型等，提供從元件到系統級的端到端模擬與設計流程，可協助學生理解資料先進中心光互連與光晶片設
計，並進一步強化教師教學、前瞻研究與跨域人才培育。 隨著 AI
基礎建設、高速光互連與先進半導體應用持續受到高度關注，光電晶片設計能力正成為新一代半導體人才培育的重

面向能力，也使產學合作在課程設計、研究導入與實務銜接上扮演更關鍵的角色。

start, we reduce your time-to-market and industrialization risks.

PDK is available in four bandwidths (C-band, O-band, 780 nm, 830 nm).

### [OptiSystem: Comprehensive Optical System Design Software][23]

OptiSystem is a comprehensive software design suite that enables users to plan, test, and simulate
optical links in the transmission layer of modern optical networks.

### [OptiSPICE: Optoelectronic Circuit Simulation][24]

OptiSPICE is the first circuit design software for analysis of integrated circuits including
interactions of optical and electronic components. It allows for the design and simulation of
opto-electronic circuits at the transistor level, from laser drivers to transimpedance amplifiers,
optical interconnects and electronic equalizers.

### [OptiFDTD: FDTD Design and Analysis for Photonic Components][25]

OptiFDTD is a powerful, highly integrated, and user friendly CAD environment that enables the design
and simulation of advanced passive and non-linear photonic components.

### [OptiInstrument: Optical System Measurement and Testing][26]

OptiInstrument is designed to addresses the needs of researchers, scientists, photonic engineers,
professors and students who are working with instruments.

### [OptiBPM: Optical Waveguide Design][27]

OptiBPM is a comprehensive CAD environment used for the design of complex optical waveguides.
Perform guiding, coupling, switching, splitting, multiplexing, and demultiplexing of optical signals
in photonic devices.

### [OptiFiber: Cutting-edge Optical Fiber Design][28]

# Room-Temperature Wafer Bonding for Next-Generation Photonics

Partow Technologies enables next-generation heterogeneous integration through advanced
room-temperature Surface Activated Bonding (SAB) and thin-film transfer technologies. Our platform
supports the integration of lithium niobate, GaN, SiC, diamond, and other advanced materials for
high-performance photonic, RF, quantum, and semiconductor applications.

By eliminating the need for high-temperature bonding, Partow’s SAB technology reduces thermal
stress, preserves material integrity, and enables scalable integration of dissimilar materials that
are difficult or impossible to combine using conventional processes.

Our technologies support a broad range of emerging applications, including AI datacenter photonics,
optical interconnects, electro-optic sensing, microwave photonics, THz systems, quantum photonics,
and advanced power electronics.

## (TFLN) photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platforms.

## About Us

## Our Capabilities

Partow provides expertise across the full integration stack, including:
* Surface Activated Wafer Bonding
* Ion-Sliced Thin-Film Transfer
* Thin-Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN)
* Heterogeneous Photonic Integration
* Advanced Wafer Engineering
* Electro-Optic Devices and Sensors

Our capabilities include wafer-scale bonding, photonic device fabrication, process development, and
custom substrate engineering for research, defense, and commercial markets.

Partow Technologies is advancing the future of photonic and semiconductor integration through
scalable, low-temperature manufacturing solutions for next-generation systems.

quantum technology innovation to support the emergence and growth of a Swedish, globally competitive
and attractive industry within and by means of quantum technology.

innovation, application development and commercialization of quantum technology.

#### Press Release

### **Quantum Computing Inc. Appoints Susan Hunt as Chief Revenue Officer and Creates Chief Product
### Officer Role to Accelerate Commercial Growth**

[Read the press release][11]

### Welcoming a new team

QCi is proud to welcome NHanced, NuCrypt, Freedom Photonics, EM4, and Optogration to the QCi family
to accelerate our transition from technology innovation to scalable manufacturing, reinforcing our
mission to put quantum-enabled solutions into the hands of people.

### NHanced

At NHanced Semiconductors we transform bleeding-edge designs into state-of-the-art 3DICs and 2.5D
assemblies.

[Visit their site][12]

### NuCrypt

NuCrypt develops inter-disciplinary technologies for emerging applications in communications and
metrology.

[Visit their site][13]

### Freedom Photonics

Freedom Photonics is a leader in design, development and manufacturing of unique and innovative
photonics components, modules and subsystems.

[Visit their site][14]

### EM4

EM4 is a leader in high-performance photonics components, modules and subassemblies with a long
heritage as a preferred supplier for leading aerospace and defense contractors around the globe.

[Visit their site][15]

### Optogration

Optogration is a leader in advanced photodetectors and detector-based components with extremely high
sensitivity and wide dynamic range for mission-critical applications.

[Visit their site][16]

## Who we are

At QCi, we build practical, scalable, room-temperature quantum photonics products that harness the
quantum nature of light to capture data, compute complex information, and securely communicate
across networks.

Our integrated quantum photonic solutions are engineered to solve real-world challenges by saving
time, reducing costs, and simplifying critical decisions.

We transform advanced quantum science into powerful tools that help people and businesses focus on
what matters most.

[vision]

## Whom we work with

We are proud to have partnered and collaborated with various industry partners, big and small.

## About QCi

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that
provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to
operate room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core
technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing,
artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

### Publications

QCi has technical talent with a range of expertise that have been publishing papers, patents, and
other scientific material. The publications fall within the categories of quantum computing,
reservoir computing, cybersecrity, biomedical imaging, remote sensing, and quantum communication.

[See publications][17]

### Join our team

We are always looking to hire world-class talent who are passionate about developing disruptive
technology that will have a positive impact on the world. Does that sound like you? Join us.

Self-Forcing Braided Sleeve Gripper: A Soft Robotics Approach to Offshore Conductor Removal

][9]
Master thesis (2026) - [C. Dielas][10], [J. Jovanova][11], J. Breukels, [V.G. Kortman][12], [H.L.
McQuillan][13], [Jieun Yang][14]

Offshore decommissioning is accelerating asageing oil and gas infrastructure reaches the end of its
service life. In theNorth Sea alone, over 2,650 wells are scheduled between 2025 and 2034, and
wellplug and abandonment accounted for 49% of decommissioning expenditure on the UKContinental Shelf
in 2024. Within this scope, conductor removal, the extractionof large-diameter vertical steel pipes
connecting subsea wells to surfacefacilities, remains a persistent operational bottleneck. Current
practice relieson the cut-and-pull method, in which the entire lifting load is transferredthrough a
single conductor cross-section. Its applicability is thereforegoverned by the structural condition
of that cross-section, as corroded casingsand degraded connections may not sustain the concentrated
load.

This thesis proposes a compliant grippingmechanism that distributes the lifting load over the outer
conductor surface,and examines whether it scales to the multi-tonne loads of conductor removal,
aregime far beyond the small-scale applications to which soft robotic grippershave been confined.
Following a literature study into soft gripping methods anda conceptual design process, four
concepts were evaluated, from which a braidedconstriction sleeve gripper was selected. Its defining
property is aself-forcing mechanism, in which the weight of the conductor tightens the braidaround
its surface, so that a heavier load produces a stronger grip.

An analytical model relates the braidgeometry to the holding capacity, which grows exponentially
with adimensionless self-forcing coefficient. This coefficient is the product of thefriction
coefficient and a geometric coefficient scaling with the conductorradius and the square of the
number of braid turns, and inversely with thegripping length. The capacity is supplied passively by
the weight of a bottomring, requiring no continuous actuation. A parametric campaign across
twelveconfigurations, each tested five times, supported the model within the rangeexamined. The
measured capacity scaled linearly with the ring weight at fixedgeometry, rose far more steeply with
the geometric coefficient than preloadfriction alone permits, following the exponential form
characteristic ofself-forcing, and followed the predicted direction for each geometric
parametervaried in isolation. A single friction coefficient of approximately 0.135reproduced the
measured capacity across differing geometries, supporting thecontact assumptions. The most tightly
braided configuration sustained more than75 kg without slipping, giving a payload-to-self-weight
ratio of at least 337:1against 16:1 at the baseline.Applied to the NorthCormorant platform, the
model yields an early-phase full-scale design employinga steel wire rope braid of seven turns over a
gripping length of 14 metres,preloaded by a 10 tonne bottom ring. Under a conservative design
frictioncoefficient of 0.10, the holding capacity reaches approximately 18,800 kNagainst a design
lifting weight of 634 kN per conductor section. Slip istherefore not the governing constraint, which
is set instead by the ropestrength at the top ring connection and by the deployment of the braid. To
theauthor's knowledge, this constitutes the first compliant gripping conceptmodelled, experimentally
supported, and dimensioned for offshore removals atthe multi-tonne scale. ... Read more

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

## Search in WebThesis

[Advanced search][14]

Webthesis portal gives access to the electronic archive of Politecnico's Master's degree theses and
meritorious theses in Architecture.

You can find in full text format:
* Master's degree theses of the courses in Cinema and Media Engineering, Electrical Engineering,
  Territorial, Urban, Environmental and Landscape Planning discussed in July 2017 (Academic Year
  2016/17);
* Most of the Master's degree theses discussed in the graduation session of October and December
  2017 (AY 2017/18);
* Master's theses of Politecnico discussed from 2018 on (AY 2017/2018).

Webthesis includes also records with abstracts for:
* The meritorious theses in Architecture discussed since 1996;
* All the Master's theses in Architecture discussed since 2010 with bibliography, index of chapters
  and tables.

Bibliographic data of the theses delivered to the Registrar's Office in electronic format and not
authorized to public consultation are also included (full-text not available).

Refer to the [contact][15] page to request changes to the accessibility of the theses.

## Hallo! This is Yue YU（俞越）!

I am currently a postdoc at [University of California, Berkeley][3] and supervised by Prof. Mengjie
Yu. Before that, I spent six years at [CUHK][4] as a postgraduate student. Pls kindly check my

During my postgraduate studies, I focus on design, fabrication, and characterization of
high-performance micro/nanodevices on various integrated photonic platforms including lithium
niobate on insulator, silicon on insulator, silica, etc. My works can be divided into following two
parts:

### (Ⅰ) Ultralow-loss integrated photonics on lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) platform
1. By applying the principle of “bound states in the continuum (BICs)”, high-performance integrated
   photonic devices were developed on a new hybrid photonic architecture at near-visible
   wavelengths, which allows confining and guiding photons using low-refractive-index waveguides
   without etching of the single-crystal substrate. Based on this strategy, a series of fundamental
   components, including waveguides, microcavities, power splitter, Mach-Zehnder interferometers,
   multimode directional couplers, were demonstrated on this platform. This work has been published
   in [[Adv. Opt. Mater. 9, 2100060 (2021)][6]].
2. On-chip arrayed waveguide gratings (AWGs) with the best reported performance yet was achieved on
   lithium niobate integrated photonic platforms. The demonstrated AWGs will enable new applications
   in high-capacity telecommunication, high-resolution imaging, and high-speed sensing. This work
   has been published in [[ACS Photonics 9, 3253–3259 (2022)][7]].
3. Acousto-optic modulation was explored on this platform to leverage the strong piezoelectric
   effect on LiNbO3. This research results have been published in [[Nanophotonics 10, 4323
   (2021)][8]]. This efficient acousto-optic modulation was further utilized to build a on-chip
   multiple passband microwave photonic (MWP) filter. Compared with former MWP filters, ours feature
   a high resolution, compact device footprint, and low energy consumption, which can be applied to
   television, mobile, satellite communications, or radar applications, where the center frequency
   is usually fixed and a narrow bandwidth is desired. This work has been published in [[Laser &
   Photon. Rev. 18, 2300385 (2024)][9]].
4. Second-harmonic-generation was also explored on this platform considering the strong optical
   nonlinearity of LiNbO3. . Due to the opposite thermo-optic coefficients of the polymer and
   lithium niobate, this our structure shows a large thermal stability with a wavelength shift of
   only 1.7 nm from 25°C to 100°C. This work has been published in [[Laser & Photon. Rev. 16,
   2100429 (2022)][10]].
5. Due to the generic mechanism of BIC, this architecture can be extended directly to other
   functional materials and easily integrated with 2D materials for different applications in
   optical communications, nonlinear optics at the single-photon level, and scalable photonic
   quantum information processors. Photon emission by sandwiching a monolayer WS2 between a
   BIC-based photonic waveguide and lithium niobate substrate was demonstrated, which holds great
   promise for building on-chip quantum light sources without fabrication challenges. This work havs
   been published in [[Nano Lett. 23, 3209-3216 (2023)][11]].
6. For those who interested on BIC-based etchless PICs, a detailed tutorial including theoretical
   analysis, numerical simulation, and fabrication processes of low-refractive-index PICs was
   published in [[J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 40, 2801-2808 (2023)][12]].

### (Ⅱ) Mechanical bound states in the continuum

To minimize the mechanical dissipation in micro/nanomechanical resonators, the concept of BIC was
applied in the design of optomechanical resonators and, for the first time, the mechanical BICs in
optomechanical resonators were experimentally realized and observed. Compared with conventional
designs, the demonstrated high-quality optomechanical resonators are robust against structural
variations, which substantially reduces the device fabrication difficulties and allows for their
operation in versatile environments. This work has been publised in [[Light Sci. Appl. 11, 328
(2022)][13]].
